shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs candidates ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- migration guide matches ---'; rg -n \"Pages Router|migrat.*App Router|Root Layout|_app|_document\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- layouts/pages ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- metadata ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- links ---'; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg 'migrat|app-router'; printf '%s\\n' '--- source pages ---'; for f in pages/*.tsx; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- configs ---'; cat tsconfig.json; cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- migration headings ---'; rg -n '"'^#{1,4} '"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- migration relevant excerpts ---'; sed -n '70,330p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- project structure ---'; sed -n '30,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/02-project-structure.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- metadata key excerpts ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"Metadata|viewport|favicon|export const metadata\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '290,390p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- link current API excerpt ---'; rg -n -C 5 \"href|Client-side transitions|export default function Page\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rmdir pages && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort && printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short && printf '%s\\n' '--- diff ---' && git diff -- app pages"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e home=$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/) about=$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/about) printf '"'%s\\n' '--- home checks ---' printf '%s' \""'$home" | rg -o '"'["'^<]+|

[''^<]+

|href="/about"'"' | head -n 5 printf '%s\\n' '--- about checks ---' printf '%s' \""'$about" | rg -o '"'["'^<]+|

[''^<]+

|href="/"'"' | head -n 5 printf '%s\\n' '--- final status ---' git status --short printf '%s\\n' '--- tsconfig diff ---' git diff -- tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\", \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next
printf '%s\\n' '--- next-env ---'
cat next-env.d.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- changed files ---'
git status --short
printf '%s\\n' '--- diff check ---'
git diff --check
printf '%s\\n' '--- migration diff stat ---'
git diff --stat -- app pages tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/about/page.tsx tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts; do echo "--- $f"; nl -ba "$f"; done; echo '"'--- status'; git status --short"
